name: context-handoff-cutover
description: Tier-P F1 scenario: on a fresh box, install the live-cutover trio (agent-worktrees + agent-dispatch + context-handoff) and assert the handoff-cutover robustness contract. It verifies the bash-first task seed, the required CLI verbs, live pane retirement, and the no-coordinator adopted-anchor fallback: durable storage outside the checkout, state-first discovery, exactly-once consumption, and anchor mux cutover resolution. Name-free / public.

provisioned_by_flow: tmux (apt, best-effort for the mechanism phase)

stages.title: the bash-first seed's CLI verbs are real
mechanism: retire verb kills a live mux pane (best-effort)
adopted anchor: no-coordinator file fallback and mux resolution
